NOTE

|     |         |
| --- | ------- |
| ✅  | Description, "Fixes #19589" and testing notes are now in the PR |
| ⚠️  | Self-review checklist is a custom one, not the one from the PR template. The description also has stray backslashes around `command` and `text`. |
| ℹ️  | Open PR #38098 already targets the same issue, and this PR doesn't explain how it relates to it. #38902 was closed for the same reason. |
| ℹ️  | The issue was claimed by @pranjal499 on 2026-06-10, after this PR was opened. CI passed. |

###### Next step

Keep "not ready" and ask the author to use the real template checklist and explain how this PR relates to #38098 (or close it in favor of that PR).

###### Reply

```quote
Thanks for updating the description! Please replace the self-review checklist with the one from the PR template, as described in our [guide on submitting a pull request](https://zulip.readthedocs.io/en/latest/contributing/reviewable-prs.html). Also, #38098 is already open for the same issue, so please explain how this PR relates to it (see our [guide on continuing unfinished work](https://zulip.readthedocs.io/en/latest/contributing/continuing-unfinished-work.html)).
```
